check_robot_hold_match: check if the robot is holding a specific object using is_robot_hold_match with PddlEntity and PddlSimInfo
set_robot_holding: set the robot to hold or release an object using set_robot_holding with a hold state and optional object
check_object_inside_receptacle: check if an object is inside an articulated receptacle using is_inside with bounding box containment logic
set_robot_position: set the robot position near an entity using set_robot_position with distance threshold and collision filtering
check_object_at_entity: check if an object is at a receptacle or goal entity using is_object_at with distance threshold
